title: The Two Ways
intro: Psalm 1 opens the Book of Psalms with a fundamental choice: two paths to walk, two destinies to face. The one who follows the Lord stands in contrast to the one who follows the wicked.

leftItems.text: Walks by the counsel of the wicked
Stands in the way of sinners
Sits in the seat of mockers
Like chaff that the wind drives away
Will not stand in the judgment

rightItems.text: Delights in the law of the Lord
Meditates on his law day and night
Like a tree planted by streams of water
The Lord knows the way of the righteous

footer: The Lord knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish. (v.6)
